text:
- chief complaint: establish care after right breast lumpectomy for ER/PR-positive DCIS.
- history of present illness: right breast calcification found on routine screening mammogram; ultrasound showed a 0.4 x 2 x 3 cm mass; core biopsy confirmed grade 2 ER/PR-positive DCIS. Lumpectomy removed an 8 mm tumor with negative margins and five benign lymph nodes. The patient received radiation and declined endocrine therapy. Most recent mammogram was normal. The patient feels well and performs regular self-breast exams without new lumps.
- physical examination: no palpable breast masses; skin thickening at the medial inferior right breast, possibly radiation changes; ECOG performance status 0.
- symptoms experienced by the patient: back pain, knee and joint pain (attributed to age), and high cholesterol (managed with diet and exercise).
- new medications prescribed or changed, including dosages: N/A.
- follow-up instructions: return visit in one year; mammogram beforehand, scheduled for April 2022.
